after.scope: same-day trip records only, over the prefix with no expedition target work — the only window in which the two trees have no legitimate source of divergence

nonVacuity.note: a matching digest over an empty set would prove nothing; 2034 records over 729 days were compared

statedLimit: the comparison stops at the first expedition target-work day BY DESIGN. Past that day the two trees legitimately differ, verification parties included, and no identity is claimed there.
